description:
Replace the empty-string sentinel of the event issue accessor with an optional typed id.

## Background

`Event::get_issue_id` returns `""` for repository-scoped events (`crates/jit/src/domain/types.rs:1989-2013`, arms `:2001,2006-2011`). Production callers are `repository_state/mutation.rs:1349` (`event_identities`, which sorts by the returned string), `domain/queries.rs:77`, `commands/events.rs:30` and `domain/event_catalog.rs`. Test callers sit in the `commands/issue.rs` test module (10), `crates/jit/tests/fast_docs_templates/bracket_breakdown_tests.rs` (2), `fast_docs_templates/document_event_log_tests.rs` (1), `fast_issue/dep_add_atomic_tests.rs` (2), `fast_issue/transitive_reduction_validation_tests.rs` (1) and `fast_rules/local_rule_enforcement_tests.rs` (1).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `EventBody::issue_id()`, and an `Event` delegate, return `Option<&IssueId>`: `Some` for issue-scoped variants and `None` for repository-scoped ones.
- [hard] REQ-02: `get_issue_id` is gone, and no event accessor returns an empty string.
- [hard] REQ-03: Event identity ordering in the mutation finalizer is unchanged: repository-scoped events still sort before issue-scoped ones.
- [hard] REQ-04: Code in this family, its unit-test modules included, uses issue ids only through `as_str()`, `short_id()`, `Display`, `Debug`, `Clone`, `PartialEq`/`Eq`, `PartialOrd`/`Ord`, `Hash` and serde, so it compiles unchanged once `IssueId` is the validated newtype.
title: Event issue accessor returns an optional IssueId
